_doc: High Plains Raceway on Lake Murray v4's engine (ledger 0078): engine lm-v4, the intake from tracks/high-plains, Lake Murray's assembler and fold weld, finer ground on the banked stretches, the bespoke dressing, engine-july's prep / export, the gates + edge_report. 0.1.11 (ledger 0097 round 3): two layouts on one road kn5 (West, Full): the north loop is the port's own connector (cut at the fork pad's box edge and the West lap's edge, rebuilt; the fork a measured pad, lm_pads, judged by verify_pads; the merge a welded mouth, its host strip gapped, judged by verify_mouths), the Full lap stitched by the author step race_laps, each layout's AC_* nodes in its own spawn kn5 (tools/circuit_dummies_blend.py race_start.layouts -> data/dummies_<id>.json -> spawn_kn5).

sync_in._road_pilot_doc: ledger 0095: the owned asphalt pair the 1ROAD override binds (texture_overrides), from airoso's tracked assets

_vegetation_doc: ledger 0089 (High Plains 0.1.6): grassfx_aerial before the track folder (the config's own GrassFX zones off NAIP 2023: the draws' long grass, B, which 0.1.5's PRAIRIECARD cards stood on, and the bright bare ground, C); no TreeFX: NAIP shows no shrub there
